keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Estudiantes de La Plata 0, Instituto 1. Facundo Suárez (Instituto) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Fernando Alarcón (Instituto) is shown the yellow card.
Diego Sosa (Instituto) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ezequiel Piovi (Estudiantes de La Plata) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santiago Núñez (Estudiantes de La Plata) is shown the yellow card.
Leonel Mosevich (Instituto) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Jeremías Lázaro (Instituto).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Instituto. Jhon Córdoba replaces Jeremías Lázaro because of an injury.
Alexis Castro (Estudiantes de La Plata) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Estudiantes de La Plata 0, Instituto 1.
Goal! Estudiantes de La Plata 0, Instituto 2. Leonel Mosevich (Instituto) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alex Luna with a cross following a corner.
Second yellow card to Santiago Núñez (Estudiantes de La Plata) for a bad foul.
Goal! Estudiantes de La Plata 0, Instituto 3. Jhon Córdoba (Instituto) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Alex Luna.
Substitution, Estudiantes de La Plata. Bautista Kociubinski replaces Alexis Castro.
Substitution, Estudiantes de La Plata. Ramiro Funes Mori replaces Joaquín Correa.
Goal! Estudiantes de La Plata 1, Instituto 3. Guido Carrillo (Estudiantes de La Plata) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ezequiel Piovi.
Substitution, Instituto. Agustín Massaccesi replaces Jonathan Galván.
Substitution, Instituto. Hernán de la Fuente replaces Giuliano Cerato.
Substitution, Instituto. Matías Tissera replaces Facundo Suárez.
